material_metadata.static_physical_dielectric: epsilon_native(r) + sum_r chi_region(r)*chi_Lorentz_r(z), constant strengths only
material_metadata.dynamic_material_equation: Physical regional polarization: Pddot+gamma Pdot+wr^2 P=f(t)*wp^2*chi_region*E; keep augmented states
material_metadata.normalization: integral E_i* epsilon_native E_j=delta_ij; M_inf=I; mu=I
material_metadata.native_coordinate_contract: D=d projected displacement; B=h native H coefficient; E=e native E coefficient; d=e+sum L P
material_metadata.material_frequency_units: Input angular omega*a/c; internal angular omega/Omega_drive
material_metadata.loss_ownership: Material damping only; native radiative linewidth is neither added nor hidden in damping
material_metadata.spatial_scope: Finite electric Galerkin projection of actual native patterned-slab modes; no full dispersive Legume spatial solve or QNM normalization
material_metadata.equation: D'=C H; B'=-C^dagger E; Pj'=Jj; Jj'=fj Lj^dagger E-Kj Pj-Gj Jj
material_metadata.polarization_coordinates: Pj and Jj are material coordinates; physical electric polarization is Lj Pj
material_metadata.scope: Supplied finite spatial operator and passive material memory; no native dispersive Legume, outgoing radiation, full continuum, or QNM residue claim

quadrature.scope: Finite-window integral only; no spectral-tail or QNM completion

radiation_metadata.coordinate_contract: Scaled displacement u: physical D=sum_i omega_i D_i u_i; native H-mode coefficient=i du_i/dt under matching units. Not a direct time-varying-H coefficient equation.
radiation_metadata.density_role: Weak-radiation real-axis density evaluated with fixed native spatial modes
radiation_metadata.negative_frequency: Measured native H(-k)^* = H(k) T; Gamma(-nu,+k)=T Gamma(nu,-k)^* T^H

reality_map_metadata.normalization_contract: Native full-space modal coordinates are orthonormal; sampled window may have nonidentity Gram but must support a unitary pointwise field map
reality_map_metadata.scope: signed real-axis Gram/power map only, no complex retarded continuation

radiation_metadata.material_reality_contract: K(+k,tau) = T K(-k,tau)^* T^H; no same-k constraint away from Gamma
radiation_metadata.loss_ownership: One memory bath only; material has no damping and no frozen gamma added
radiation_metadata.reactive_reference: Kernel completion as written; no fitted counterterm or missing-tail correction
radiation_metadata.outside_window: Density set to zero as an explicit model truncation, not asserted physically zero
radiation_metadata.system_bath_modulation: Bath is stationary; only projected physical permittivity is time modulated

bath_equation: h'=-i W e-Lr; r'=-(eta+i nu)r+L^H h
nondispersive_similarity: d=W q; h=i v; r_new=i r_old
loss_ownership: Material G acts only on J; radiation memory acts only through h; no native diagonal Q added
scope: Finite native electric Galerkin + material ADE + stationary finite-window broadened native bath; no unique full Maxwell/QNM self-energy
native_bath_reference: Fixed epsilon_inf modes and channels; material-induced changes in exterior coupling are not re-solved
